# Public watch-page fixtures

Fetched 2026-11-27 using normal unauthenticated HTTP GET of the source URLs recorded in each JSON document. HTTP status was 200.

The JSON fixtures contain only observed public offer anchors and provider logos, with TMDB and JustWatch attribution. The HTML fixture preserves the observed element structure and relevant anchor, identity, visibility, and image attributes; page prose, scripts, cookies, and unrelated attribute values are removed. Fixture construction does not invent provider destinations.

Shawshank and Matrix cover US/GB rent, buy, and subscription offers. Breaking Bad covers the exact Netflix title destination. Night of the Living Dead covers US/GB free, ads, subscription, rental, and purchase offers, including small providers. Source-provided YouTube search URLs and an Apple TV homepage remain in these fixtures to verify that reported availability never becomes a fabricated exact-title action.

These are dated observations for parser regression tests, not current availability promises or an exhaustive catalog. Upstream attribution and current terms remain applicable.
